title: Fiilka 'to be' (am/is/are)
bridge: Af-Soomaali waxaannu leenay fiil-fiil: 'ser' iyo 'estar'. Ingiriisiy oo kalena fiil kale ah ma jira: 'to be'. Walaacda wanaagsan waxay tahay in Af-Soomaali oo kalena aannu isticmaalay 'ser/estar' si aan u soo dhaafay xaalad iyo xaalad, sida Ingiriisiy. Farqiga ugu muhiimsan waxay tahay in Ingiriisiy MAADAAMA aynu fogeeyey qaybta ugu horeeya: mar walba baad u baahan doontaa 'I am', 'you are', 'he is', iyada oo kale.
rule: Fiilka 'to be' muddada hadda waxay leeyihiin shakhsan: 'am' (ee 'I'), 'is' (ee 'he, she, it') iyo 'are' (ee 'you, we, they'). Si aad u sameeyo su'aalo, xili'aaddu wuxuu la soo diray: 'Are you...?', 'Is he...?'. Si aad u diida, 'not' ayaa la ku daray: 'I am not', 'he is not' (ama 'he isn't'), 'they are not' (ama 'they aren't').

concept_examples.translation: Ma adag tahay? (sawir: Ma adag tahay?)

common_error.explanation: Af-Soomaali waxaannu leenay 'Anigu adag ah', fiilka ka baxsan, laakiin Ingiriisiy fiilka 'to be' waa la doonayaa. Ha u fogeesi 'am/is/are'.

examples.note: Waxaynu isticmaalay 'is' qaybta saddexaad ee isku mid.
Shaklaha qaawanaanta 'aren't' waxay nuusan tahay fiican oo kala duwan.
Waxaynu soo diray qaybta ugu horeeya iyo fiil si aan u sameeyo su'aalo.

title: Personal Pronouns (I, you, he, she, it, we, they)
bridge: Faransiiska, isku duwanada shakhsiya waxay u dhexeeya: anigu, adigu, isagu, iyadu, annagu, idinku, iyagu. Tafaarka ugu weyn waa ingiriishiisu kasta mar ay isticmaalayaan isku duwana shakhsiya sida hadalka ugu horeeya, haddii loo qalmo faransiiska: 'I am tired' (maahee 'am tired'). Haddaba fiirso inaad isku dayo 'he' iyo 'she' — ingiriishiisu wuxuu u taliyaa jinsiga jicilka ah, maaha jinsiga qoraalka sida faransiiska.
rule: Isku duwana shakhsiya ingiriishiisu waa: I (anigu), you (adigu/aad/idinku), he (isagu), she (iyadu), it (waxaad), we (annagu), they (iyagu). 'It' waxaa la isticmaalaa waxyaabaha, niyicyada iyo fikradaha. 'You' waxaa la isticmaalaa isku duwan u dhexeeya iyo isku duwan badan. Ingiriishiisu had iyo goorba ma la qalmo hadalka ugu horeeya.

common_error.correct: He is a teacher. / She is a teacher.
common_error.explanation: Faransiiska waxaynu leennahay 'Es profesor' hadalka ugu horeeya oo loo qalmay, laakiin ingiriishiisu isku duwana shakhsiya waa in la qaado. Hada iyo goorba waxaad idin lahaa inaad tidhaahda 'He is...' ama 'She is...'.

examples.note: Isku duwan ugu horeeya u dhexeeya.

levels.label: Third person singular
levels.translation: Isku duwan ugu saddexa u dhexeeya

examples.note: 'It' waxaa la isticmaalaa waxyaabaha, niyicyada iyo waxyaabaha xaaladda leh.

translations.so: Personal Pronouns (I, you, he, she, it, we, they)

title: Articles (a/an, the)
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga waxaannu leenaynaa qaabab: 'un/una' (aan la sheeginayn) iyo 'el/la/los/las' (la sheegay). Tafaafkooyinka mooliis ahaan wuxuu ah in Af-Ingiriisiga 'the' aan isticmaalayn concepts oo umuma ah (waxaynu leennahay 'Life is beautiful', 'The life is beautiful' maayo). Xusuuso in la adeegsanayo 'a' ama 'an' Af-Ingiriisiga qaybo (waxaynu leennahay 'I am a teacher' - Af-Soomaaliga waxaynu leennahay 'Waxaan qayb qaadan qayb qaadan' qaabab la'aan).
rule: Waxaynu isticmaalannaa 'a' erayada oo bilaabay dhawan casaan ah (a book, a car). Waxaynu isticmaalannaa 'an' erayada oo bilaabay dhawan abuur ah (an apple, an hour - 'h' ma ayuu ku hadlimo). Waxaynu isticmaalannaa 'the' inaanu u sheegno wax xusuusan ama la hadlay. 'The' ma aynu isticmaalayn concepts oo umuma ah (Love is important, 'The love' maayo).

common_error.explanation: Af-Soomaaliga waxaynu leennahay 'Waxaan qayb qaadan qayb qaadan' qaabab la'aan. Af-Ingiriisiga, qaybo, waxaynu isticmaalannaa 'a' ama 'an'.

examples.note: Waxaynu isticmaalannaa 'a' erayada oo bilaabay dhawan casaan ah.
Waxaynu isticmaalannaa 'an' erayada oo bilaabay dhawan abuur ah.
'The' waxaynu isticmaalannaa wax xusuusan ama la ogaaday.
Concepts oo umuma ah, 'the' ma aynu isticmaalayn.

title: Plurales regulares e irregulares básicos
bridge: Farangaashiis, waxaan u sameeynaa cadaanno -s ama -es (casa → casas, reloj → relojes). Ingiriisi baa u eg yahay: badankii erayada waxay ku daraan -s (book → books), laakiin sharciyo khaas ah oo leh: haddii eraydu qoraan -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z, waxaan ku darnaa -es (bus → buses, watch → watches). Sidoo kale waxaa jira cadaanno aan la ogaayn (child → children, foot → feet) oo aan raagin sharciyadaas iyo cadaanno aan la iibin.
rule: Sharciyo cadaanno ku saabsan: 1) Ku dar -s (cat → cats). 2) Ku dar -es haddii eraydu qoraan -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z (box → boxes, dish → dishes). 3) Haddii qoraan -y oo horay u noqotoconstant, bedel -y si aad u noqoto -ies (city → cities). 4) Haddii qoraan -f ama -fe, mar walba bedel si aad u noqoto -ves (wolf → wolves, knife → knives). Cadaanno aan la ogaayn waxay yihiin cadaanno aan la ogaayn: child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, man → men, woman → women, mouse → mice, sheep → sheep (isku mid), fish → fish (isku mid).

common_error.explanation: Farangaashiis, dhammaan cadaanno waxay ku saabsan yihiin (niño → niños), laakiin Ingiriisi 'child' waa mid aan la ogaayn iyo cadaankuu 'children'. Waxaa jira khalad weyn oo ku saabsan erayada Soomaaliga oo ku dar -s.

examples.note: Cadadu wuxuu u eg yahay midka hore.

title: Cadceeda guud (I eat, you eat, he eats)
bridge: Farriisniinku, aannu nagaa cadceeda guud inay u adeegsan tahay shuqulka adaaha: 'Waxaan pizza uun la qaato kasta. Ingiriishiina waa sidii ay tahay, laakiin furqan weyn ah: qaybta saddexaad (he, she, it) waxaannu ku daranna -s fiilka (he eats, she works). Waxaannu u baahanahay inaan isticmaalno 'do/does' su'aalooyinka iyo diidaamooyinka, sida ay farriisniinku tahay '¿...?' la codsi, laakiin halkan waa la qalmo.
rule: Cadceeda guud wuxuu u sameeyaa fiilka aasaasiga oo dhan dadka ah, isaga la mid ah qaybta saddexaad ee isaga (he, she, it), maxaa yeelay waxaannu ku daranna -s (ama -es haddii ay dhammaan -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z). Su'aalooyinka iyo diidaamooyinka waxaannu isticmaalnaa 'do' (for I, you, we, they) ama 'does' (for he, she, it) + fiilka aasaasiga (ilaa -s). Ex: 'I eat', 'He eats', 'Do you eat?', 'She doesn't eat'.

concept_examples.translation: Waxaan furaad qaataa 8 saacad daqiiqo ah.

common_error.explanation: Farriisniinku, qaybta saddexaad ee isaga ma lehay dhammaan xusuus oo leh cadceeda (isagu wuxuu cunayaa), laakiin Ingiriishiisu waxaa lagu darayaa -s (isagu wuxuu cunayaa). Tani waa mid ka mid ah khaladaha ugu badan ee ku tashan kuwa hadal farriisniin.

examples.original: She reads a book every day.

examples.translation: Ma ay laga shaqeeyaa kubadda cagta?

translations.so: Cadceeda guud (I eat, you eat, he eats)

title: Adverbios de frecuencia (always, sometimes, never)
bridge: Faransiiska, kalaamadaha midaabaanka oo 'siempre', 'a veces' iyo 'nunca' u eg yahay, waxay ku noqon karta inay horay u noqdaan fiilka: 'Yo siempre como pizza' ama dibadda fiilka qaarkood. Ingiriishi, goostu wuxuu u eg yahay: waxay ku noqon karta inay horay u noqdaan fiilka ugu muhiimsan (I always eat pizza), laakiin dibadda fiilka 'to be' (I am always tired). Tifaacadda ugu muhiimsan waxay tahay in Faransiiska waxaynu u qorin karnaa dibadda eachbaddu, laakiin Ingiriishi waxa uu u eg yahay inaanu u qorino.
rule: Kalaamadaha midaabaanka ugu caansan waxay tahay: always (siempre), usually (normalmente), often (a menudo), sometimes (a veces), rarely (raramente), never (nunca). Waxay ku noqon karta inay horay u noqdaan fiilka ugu muhiimsan (I always go to school), laakiin dibadda fiilka 'to be' (I am always happy). Su'aalooyinka, waxay ku noqon karta inay dibadda eachbaddu u noqdaan (Do you always eat breakfast?)

concept_examples.text: I always drink coffee in the morning.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz drɪŋk ˈkɒfi ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: They sometimes go to the cinema.
concept_examples.translation: Iyagu waxay u dhaqaaqo cinema qaarkood.
Miyeyad uun joogaa kharash ka baxay?

common_error.explanation: Faransiiska waxaynu leenay 'Yo siempre como pizza' ama 'Yo como pizza siempre'. Ingiriishi, kalaamadu midaabaanka wuxuu ku noqon kartaa inuu horay u noqdaan fiilka ugu muhiimsan (always eat). Inuu dibadda u noqdo wuxuu u eg yahay inuu u tarjumay Faransiiska si adag.

examples.original: I always get up at 7 am.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz ɡet ʌp æt ˈsevən æm/

examples.translation: Anagu ma aynu cunin cunto xawaaro.

examples.note: Kalaamadu wuxuu ku noqon kartaa inuu dibadda fiilka 'to be' u noqdo.

title: Have got / Has got
bridge: Faransiiska, si aad u sheegto milkiyyaad waxaan isticmaamo fiilka 'tener': 'Yo tengo un coche'. Ingiriishi, labo hab oo leh: 'have' (I have a car) iyo 'have got' (I have got a car). 'Have got' waxay ku caan tahay Ingiriishi-British oo lagu isticmaalo qaybaha aan rasmi ahayn. Xaqiiqdu, waxay isku mid tahay, laakiin 'have got' waxaa badan lagu isticmaalo hal-marta. Halkaan iyo su'aasha, 'have got' waxay isticmaalaa fiilka kaalinka 'have' oo aan 'do/does' u isticmlin. Misaal: 'I haven't got a car' iyo 'Have you got a car?'.
rule: Have got / Has got waxay u isticmaalataan in lagu sheego milkiyyaad, xiriir, xusuusooyinka jisimiga ah iyo waajibooyin. Kadib: I/you/we/they have got, he/she/it has got. Kala duwan: I/you/we/they have not got (haven't got), he/she/it has not got (hasn't got). Su'aalo: Have I/you/we/they got? Has he/she/it got? 'Do/does' ma lagu isticmlin. Su'aalo qaansan: Yes, I have / No, I haven't. Waxay badan lagu isticmaalo hal-marta; waqti kale waxaa lagu isticmaalo 'have' oo kalese.

concept_examples.text: I have got a new phone.

common_error.explanation: Faransiiska, 'tener' waxay u tarjumayaan 'have' ama 'have got'. Laakiin 'have got' waxay isticmaalaa shirka 'got', aan 'get' u isticmlin. Inaad dhahdo 'I have get' waa khalad aan ku soo jeedinayo xogta asalka ah. Xusuuso: 'have got' waxay u isticmaalataan milkiyyaad hal-marta.

examples.original: We have got a big house.

examples.note: Waxaan isticmaan 'has got' saddexad ee shakhsi.
Su'aalo ku soo jeedinayo 'have/has' iyo shakhsi.

title: Prepositions of place (in, on, under, next to)
bridge: Faransiiska, aannu ku isticmaalo preposition 'en' wax kastaba ha ahaatee: 'en la casa', 'en la mesa', 'en la calle'. Ingiriishi, ayuu prepositions of place badan oo doonashooyinku wuxuu u adeegsan yahay si taxaddar leh. 'In' waxay u adeegsan yahay qolal danbe ah ama qolal saddex-dhexdehada ah (in the room), 'on' waxay u adeegsan yahay suuragal (on the table), 'under' waxay u adeegsan yahay hoosti (under the bed) oo 'next to' waxay u adeegsan yahay dhinaca (next to the door). Hadana xusuuso in 'en la esquina' waxay u hadlayaan 'on the corner' (maahee 'in').
rule: Prepositions of place asasiyada ah: in (dhexdhexaad), on (ku celi), under (hoosti), next to (dhinaca). Sidee kalana: behind (dhinaca hoosti), in front of (hore), between (dhexdhexaad). Ingiriishi-British, oo u adeegsan yahay nidaamka, waxay u hadlayaan 'on the bus', 'on the train', laakiin 'in the car'. Su'aalooyin: 'Where is the cat?' → 'It is under the table.'

concept_examples.text: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the bed.
concept_examples.translation: Birta waxay ku jirta hoosti shaciiska.

concept_examples.text: The supermarket is next to the bank.
concept_examples.translation: Dukaanka cuntada wuxuu ku jira dhinaca bankiga.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈsuːpəmɑːkɪt ɪz nekst tə ðə bæŋk/

common_error.explanation: Faransiiska, waxaynu leedahay 'en el autobús' wax kastaba ha ahaatee, laakiin Ingiriishi, oo u adeegsan yahay nidaamka dadweynaha (bus, train, plane), waxay isticmaalaan 'on', maaha 'in'. 'In' waxay u adeegsan yahay gaadiidka iyo taaksiyada (in the car).

examples.original: The milk is in the fridge.
examples.translation: Siiro waxay ku jirta qalabka qabowjiyaha.
examples.note: Aannu ku isticmaalo 'in' qolal danbe ah.

examples.original: The keys are on the table.
My shoes are under the chair.
examples.translation: Haggahaygu waxay ku jira hoosti kunkunka.

examples.original: The school is next to the church.
examples.phonetic: /ðə skuːl ɪz nekst tə ðə tʃɜːtʃ/
examples.translation: Xoolaha waxay ku jira dhinaca masajidka.

translations.so: Prepositions of place (in, on, under, next to)

title: Demostrativos (this, that, these, those)
bridge: Farigaagiis, waxa ay noogu leeyihiin 'kan' (dhow), 'ka' (dhexdeedaad) iyo 'ka' (durba). Ingiriisi, labada xilli ah ayuu leeyahay: 'this' (singular) iyo 'these' (plural) oo dhow; 'that' (singular) iyo 'those' (plural) oo durba. Wareegnimada ugu weyn ee ku saabsan af-Soomaaliga waxay tahay inaan furanayn 'ka' iyo 'ka' Ingiriisi, oo markii aan arkin jirno wax walba waxaan u isticmaali 'this', haddii ay durba tahay. Waxay adag oo keliya u isticmaali 'these' (kan) iyo 'this' (kan) oo leh adag.
rule: Waxaan isticmaalnaa 'this' oo dhow (singular). Waxaan isticmaalnaa 'these' oo dhow (plural). Waxaan isticmaalnaa 'that' oo durba (singular). Waxaan isticmaalnaa 'those' oo durba (plural). Isticmaalna waa in la isticmaalo tashriif: 'This is my friend' (markii uu u joogaa) iyo 'That is my house' (markii aad u soo jeedaa durba).

common_error.explanation: Farigaagiis, 'kan' iyo 'kan' waxay kala duwan yihiin, laakiin markii ay af-Soomaaliga ku dhacdo ayay khalad u isticmaali 'this' oo plural, ama ayay ku khalad tahay adagada 'these' /ðiːz/ iyo 'this' /ðɪs/. Xusuuso in 'this' waxay noqotaa singular iyo 'these' waxay noqotaa plural.

title: Can (awood iyo xaalad)
bridge: Faransiiska, aannu u isticmaalo 'poder' inay u dhejiyaan awood ('puedo nadar') iyo xaalad ('¿puedo ir?'). Ingiriiska, 'can' wuxuu kala duwan yahay labada isticmaal. Faa'iidada weyn waa 'can' ku dhowaad ay iska baxdo saddexad (he can, she can) iyo ma uu baahan yahay 'to' ka dib (I can swim, no 'I can to swim'). Si kastaba ha ahaatee, su'aalo iyo diidaamo aannu isticmaalo 'do/does' laakiin aannu beddelno xilli (Can you swim?) ama aannu ku daranno 'not' (I cannot / can't). Wuxuu yahay fiil modal, sidaa darteed wuxuu la socda fiilka oo aan 'to' lahayn.
rule: 'Can' wuxuu isticmaal yahay: 1) awood (I can play the piano), 2) xaalad (Can I go to the bathroom?), 3) suuragal (It can rain tomorrow). Wuxuu ku dhowaad uun la mid yahay dadka oo dhan. Kadib: I/you/he/she/it/we/they can + fiilka asas. Diidaamo: cannot (can't) + fiilka asas. Su'aalo: Can + isaga + fiilka asas? Jawabo qaano ah: Yes, I can / No, I can't.

concept_examples.translation: Waan ku fiicnaa inaan u naqo si fiican.
Ayay u dhaqan karaa luqado saddex.
Wuxuu ma ayuu u qaadan karo dhaw.

common_error.explanation: Faransiiska, aannu idhaahdo 'puedo cantar' oo aan preposition lahayn. Ingiriiska, 'can' wuxuu la socda fiilka oo aan 'to' lahayn. Inaad idhaahdo 'can to' waa khalad weyn oo ku tashan xaaladda kale ee fiilasha uu la socda 'to' (want to, need to).

examples.translation: Waan og yahay inaan u cunto.
Ayay ma ayay u helin keysada.

examples.original: Can they come? Yes, they can.
examples.translation: Ma ayay u imanayaan? Haa, ayay u imanayaan.
examples.note: Su'aal xog-ogaadan iyo jawaab qaano ah.

title: Su’aalooyin 'wh-' (what, where, who, when)
bridge: Farcee’iska, waxaynu su’aalooyin sameeynaa erayado sida 'maxaa', 'meesha', 'yaa', 'markii'. Ingiriisi, waxay u dhexeeya: 'what' (maxaa), 'where' (meesha), 'who' (yee), 'when' (markii). Xaqiiqdu wuxuu ah: Erayga wh- + fiilka waaweyn (ama fiilka 'to be') + isaga + fiilka ugu badnaa? Misaal: 'Where do you live?' (Meesha aad nooshahay?). Wareegnimo leh kuwa hadalka Soomaaliga ah ay yihiin inay xusuusan fiilka waaweyn 'do/does' muddada aad u jira, iyo inay aan u jeedin tarta su’aalooyinka aan xad gudba (sida 'Can you tell me where the station is?' – saxiixday, 'where is the station' ma aha su’aalo aan xad gudba).
rule: Su’aalooyinka wh- waxay noqonayaa sidaas: 1) Fiilka 'to be': Erayga wh- + am/is/are + isaga? (Where is the bank?). 2) Fiilka 'can': Erayga wh- + can + isaga + fiil? (What can you do?). 3) Muddada aad u jira (fiilasha kale): Erayga wh- + do/does + isaga + fiilka asas? (What do you eat?). 4) Su’aalooyinka aan xad gudba (ka dib 'Can you tell me...', 'Do you know...'), tarta wuxuu ah: isaga + fiil (aan u jeedin): 'Can you tell me where the station is?' (aan 'where is the station').

common_error.wrong: Can you tell me where is the station?
common_error.correct: Can you tell me where the station is?
common_error.explanation: Farcee’iska, su’aalooyinka aan xad gudba waxaynu ku dhex jirnaa tarta su’aalooyinka aan xad gudba: '¿Puedes decirme dónde está la estación?'. Ingiriisi, su’aalooyinka aan xad gudba, tarta wuxuu ah: isaga + fiil, aan u jeedin. Waxaa jira khalad aad u badan ee kuwa hadalka Soomaaliga ah.

examples.note: Su’aalo aan u qaato xogta wax.

title: There is / Waxay jiraan
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, inoo dhaha 'waxay jiraan' waxaan isticmaamo eray kalaha ah: 'waxay jiraan'. Af-Ingiriis, kala duwan ah ay yihiin: 'there is' (singular) iyo 'there are' (plural). Doorteeda waxay oggolaan dhammaan oo dheeraad ah. Misaal: 'There is a book on the table' (Waxay jira buug oo ku xidhnaysa mishaaree), 'There are two books on the table' (Laba buug oo ku xidhnaysa mishaaree). Waxay isticmaalayaan su'aalo: 'Is there a bank near here?' iyo 'Are there any restaurants?'. Wareega ee ku salaysan af-Soomaaliga waxay ku qalad u dhaqan 'there is/are' iyo 'have' (waxay dhahaan 'The house has a garden' mar walba 'There is a garden in the house').
rule: Waxaan isticmaamo 'There is' dhammaan oo la tirin karo singular iyo aan la tirin karo (There is some water). Waxaan isticmaamo 'There are' dhammaan oo la tirin karo plural (There are three chairs). Su'aalo: Is there...? / Are there...? Kala duwan: There isn't / There aren't. Waxay isticmaalayaan 'any' su'aalo iyo kala duwan: 'Is there any milk?' (Ma jira adhadh?) iyo 'There isn't any milk' (Adhadh ma jiro).

concept_examples.text: There is a cat in the garden.
concept_examples.translation: Waxay jira bir qasab oo ku xidhnaysa beeraha.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə kæt ɪn ðə ˈɡɑːdən/

concept_examples.text: There are two chairs in the kitchen.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːr tuː tʃeəz ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn/

concept_examples.text: Is there a bank near here?
concept_examples.translation: Ma jira bank oo ku dhow rsaan?

concept_examples.text: There aren't any students in the class.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːnt ˈeni ˈstjuːdənts ɪn ðə klɑːs/

common_error.wrong: In my house have a garden.
common_error.correct: There is a garden in my house.
common_error.explanation: Af-Soomaaliga waxay nuugu dhahantahay 'Guryeyga waxay leeyihiin beer' isticmaalaya 'tener', laakiin af-Ingiriisi, inoo dhaha waxay jiraan, waxaan isticmaamo 'there is/are', aan isticmaalino 'have'. Qalad aan u adag tahay waxaa uu u dhaxeeyaa tarjumaad dhaqanka. Waxaad dhahdaa 'My house has a garden' (tener) badelniin, laakiin 'there is' waxay u badan tahay inay isticmaali doonaan meel.

examples.original: There is a phone on the desk.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə fəʊn ɒn ðə desk/
examples.translation: Waxay jira telefoon oo ku xidhnaysa qoraaga.

examples.original: There are three cars in the street.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːr θriː kɑːrz ɪn ðə striːt/
examples.translation: Saddex dhumuc oo ku xidhnaysa sharaacada.

levels.label: Questions with Is there / Are there

examples.original: Are there any eggs in the fridge?
examples.phonetic: /ɑːr ðeər ˈeni eɡz ɪn ðə frɪdʒ/

examples.original: There isn't any sugar in the cupboard.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ˈɪzənt ˈeni ˈʃʊɡər ɪn ðə ˈkʌbəd/
examples.note: Kala duwan 'any' oo ku salaysan aan la tirin karo.
